scope.title: What changes in the managed mode
scope.guids: AI agents (GUIDS), knowledge base and referrals
scope.keyNote: The company's AI key is never read or replaced by the managing team.
scope.auditNote: Every action of the managing team is recorded in the workspace audit.

settings.title: Service mode
settings.description: Who operates the workspace: the company alone (standard) or the managing team (managed).
settings.standardNote: In the standard mode, the managing team only sees the status of the modules, without the data. Support only through the temporary access you approve.
settings.pendingDescription: {partner} asked to manage this company. The request is valid until {date}.
settings.ownerOnly: Only the company owner approves, denies or goes back to the standard mode.
settings.backDescription: The company operates alone again and the access of the managing team ends at once. Going back to managed will need a new request.

link.title: Management request
link.expires: This link can be used once and is valid until {date}.
link.consent: When you decide, we record the date, time and network address (IP) as proof of your consent.
link.notFound: This link does not exist or does not belong to this address.
link.expired: The request has expired. Ask the managing team for a new request.
link.approved: {partner} can now manage {organization}. You can go back to the standard mode at any time in Settings › Service mode.
link.denied: Nothing changed: {organization} stays in the standard mode.
link.cancelled: The request was cancelled by who made it. Nothing changed.
